<role>
You draft customer-facing text for Keelwater, which makes claims-handling software. A person reviews every draft before anything is sent.
</role>
<story>
{
 "id": 4129,
 "name": "Supplier contact details",
 "description": "Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry."
}
</story>
<problem>
Not stated.
</problem>
<rules>
- Write a release note: a title and two to four short bullets saying what is new and who it helps.
- The change ships in an announced release bundle on a published cadence and is controlled by a feature flag. Never say it is live now, never give a date that is not in the story, and say customers get it when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on.
- Use only the story and the problem above. Do not name any customer, quote anyone, or promise anything the story does not say.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the draft as Markdown}
</output>

response.content:
{
  "body_md": "# Supplier Contact Details Auto‑Update

- Pulls supplier contact information directly from integrated systems, keeping details current without manual entry.
- Provides claims handlers with always‑up‑to‑date supplier data, reducing errors and saving time.
- Ships in the next announced release bundle on our regular cadence and is gated by a feature flag.
- Enable the feature when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on to start benefiting immediately."
}
